guide.title: Guide
guide.intro: A short guide by task. Open it any time with F1 or from the command palette.

addDocs.title: Add documents
addDocs.body: Drop PDF files or a folder into the window, or use Add PDF in To review (Alt+2). The app reads titles and metadata, files them in your library and shows what it found for you to confirm. Your originals are never changed.

tags.title: Organize with tags and projects
tags.body: Select documents in the Library and give them tags from your taxonomy, or add them to a project. You can undo any change with Undo, in the top bar. The search box finds text, titles and authors; the advanced search can also ask Claude.

read.title: Read and annotate
read.body: Double-click a document to open it in the reader. Select text to highlight or underline it and to add a note. Notes, highlights and citations are saved in your library folder and travel with it.

chat.title: Ask Claude
chat.body: Open Claude from the sidebar (Ctrl+J) and use the command palette for ready-made requests. Claude only sees documents in folders you have enabled for it, and you can preview exactly what is sent before you send.

network.title: Explore the map
network.body: The Map section (Alt+5) draws documents, authors and topics as a map and as a graph, so you can find clusters and related work. It is built from your own library and rebuilt when needed.

export.title: Export and connect other tools
export.body: Export a project or a selection as a second brain (notes with links) from the command palette. In the settings you can also start a local MCP server so other tools can read your library.

backup.title: Back up your library
backup.body: In the settings choose a destination folder and press Back up now, or turn on the automatic backup. A backup can be verified and restored as a new library at any time. Secrets such as API keys are never saved in a backup.

welcome.title: Welcome to Research Lab
welcome.body: Your library is ready. The guide explains the main tasks in a few lines.

tips.palette: Press {{palette}} for the command palette: go anywhere, back up, ask Claude.
tips.search: Press {{search}} to jump to the search box.
tips.backup: Set up a backup in the settings so your notes are never lost.
